instrumentation: Appends a read-only reference to existing sessions module objects; no API/function behavior replacement. Inputs use fill/Tab, checkbox, mouse, or trusted browser touch contacts.

definitions.name: RS485

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: TTL/UART to differential RS485 transceiver. Official driver sends host UART TX over yellow and receives on white (UIFlow tuple white,yellow); default init helper is 9600 8N1. Unit protocol bytes depend on the connected peer; no generic fixed Modbus address is implied.
gaps: Product lists external DC12V input and red wire 5V; exact power direction/regulation and automatic direction-control timing need schematic confirmation.
Electrical differential voltage, bus termination and collision behavior are not inferred from UART bytes.
